newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber mostly weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber mostly weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: All Kobe rubber futures except for the spot December contract were weaker in extremely thin after-hours trade on Thursday after drifting within tight ranges during the day, traders said.
The benchmark May contract was 0.4 yen per kg lower than the day's close at 142.0 yen. Other prices ranged from 0.8 yen lower to 0.4 yen up. Volume was 2,778 lots.
The market opened easier, reflecting the yen's firmer tone.
"Direction hinges on overseas markets. If rains in producing countries are prolonged, the overseas markets could be lifted," one trader said.
